   1 class_name SaveRepository extends RefCounted
   2 
   3 const VERSION: int = 1
   4 const BROWSER_KEY: String = "velvet_eclipse_save_v1"
   5 const MAX_SAVE_BYTES: int = 65536
   6 var bridge_evaluator: Callable
   7 var last_read_acknowledged: bool = false
   8 var path: String = "user://velvet_eclipse_save.json"
   9 var last_error: String = ""
  10 
  11 func _init(save_path: String = "user://velvet_eclipse_save.json", evaluator: Callable = Callable()) -> void:
  12 	path = save_path
  13 	bridge_evaluator = evaluator
  14 
  15 func validate(payload: Variant, rooms: RoomCatalog, resources: ResourceCatalog) -> Dictionary:
  16 	last_error = ""
  17 	if not payload is Dictionary:
  18 		return _reject("存档格式无效")
  19 	var version: Variant = payload.get("version")
  20 	if not (version is int or version is float) or version != VERSION:
  21 		return _reject("存档版本不受支持或文件已损坏")
  22 	for key in ["checkpoint_id", "room_id", "spawn_id"]:
  23 		if not payload.get(key) is String or payload[key].is_empty():
  24 			return _reject("存档地点格式无效")
  25 	for key in ["moonstep", "boss_defeated", "ending_seen"]:
  26 		if not payload.get(key) is bool:
  27 			return _reject("存档进度格式无效")
  28 	if not payload.get("visited_rooms") is Array:
  29 		return _reject("存档地图格式无效")
  30 	var discovered: Array[String] = []
  31 	for room_id in payload.visited_rooms:
  32 		if not room_id is String or not rooms.ROOM_PATHS.has(room_id):
  33 			return _reject("存档包含未知房间")
  34 		if not room_id in discovered:
  35 			discovered.append(room_id)
  36 	var room: Dictionary = rooms.load_room(payload.room_id, resources)
  37 	if room.is_empty() or not room.spawns.has(payload.spawn_id):
  38 		return _reject("存档出生点无效")
  39 	var initial: bool = payload.checkpoint_id == "start" and payload.room_id == "grand_lobby" and payload.spawn_id == "start"
  40 	var shrine: Variant = room.get("checkpoint")
  41 	if not initial and (not shrine is Dictionary or shrine.id != payload.checkpoint_id or shrine.spawn_id != payload.spawn_id):
  42 		return _reject("存档检查点无效")
  43 	if not payload.room_id in discovered or not "grand_lobby" in discovered:
  44 		return _reject("存档地图缺少检查点")
  45 	if payload.moonstep and not "roulette_clocktower" in discovered:
  46 		return _reject("存档月步发现记录无效")
  47 	if payload.boss_defeated and (not payload.moonstep or not "house_throne" in discovered):
  48 		return _reject("存档胜利记录无效")
  49 	if payload.ending_seen and not payload.boss_defeated:
  50 		return _reject("存档结局状态无效")
  51 	if payload.room_id == "quiet_save_room" and not payload.moonstep:
  52 		return _reject("存档缺少月步能力")
  53 	return {"version": VERSION, "checkpoint_id": payload.checkpoint_id, "room_id": payload.room_id, "spawn_id": payload.spawn_id, "moonstep": payload.moonstep, "visited_rooms": discovered, "boss_defeated": payload.boss_defeated, "ending_seen": payload.ending_seen}
  54 
  55 func read_save(rooms: RoomCatalog, resources: ResourceCatalog) -> Dictionary:
  56 	last_read_acknowledged = false
  57 	if uses_browser_storage():
  58 		var response: Dictionary = _browser_result(browser_script("read"))
  59 		if response.is_empty():
  60 			return {}
  61 		var stored: Variant = response.get("value")
  62 		if stored == null:
  63 			return _reject("暂无存档")
  64 		if not stored is String or stored.to_utf8_buffer().size() > MAX_SAVE_BYTES:
  65 			return _reject("浏览器存档大小或格式无效")
  66 		var payload: Dictionary = _decode(stored, rooms, resources)
  67 		last_read_acknowledged = not payload.is_empty()
  68 		return payload
  69 	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
  70 		return _reject("暂无存档")
  71 	var file := FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
  72 	if file == null:
  73 		return _reject("无法读取存档")
  74 	if file.get_length() > MAX_SAVE_BYTES:
  75 		file.close()
  76 		return _reject("存档大小无效")
  77 	var text: String = file.get_as_text()
  78 	file.close()
  79 	return _decode(text, rooms, resources)
  80 
  81 func write_save(payload: Dictionary, rooms: RoomCatalog, resources: ResourceCatalog) -> bool:
  82 	var valid: Dictionary = validate(payload, rooms, resources)
  83 	if valid.is_empty():
  84 		return false
  85 	if uses_browser_storage():
  86 		var encoded: String = JSON.stringify(valid)
  87 		if encoded.to_utf8_buffer().size() > MAX_SAVE_BYTES:
  88 			last_error = "存档大小无效"
  89 			return false
  90 		var response: Dictionary = _browser_result(browser_script("write", encoded))
  91 		if response.is_empty():
  92 			return false
  93 		if not response.get("value") is String or response.value != encoded:
  94 			last_error = "浏览器存档写入校验失败"
  95 			return false
  96 		return true
  97 	var temporary: String = path + ".tmp"
  98 	var file := FileAccess.open(temporary, FileAccess.WRITE)
  99 	if file == null:
 100 		last_error = "无法写入存档：" + error_string(FileAccess.get_open_error())
 101 		return false
 102 	file.store_string(JSON.stringify(valid))
 103 	file.flush()
 104 	var error: Error = file.get_error()
 105 	file.close()
 106 	if error != OK:
 107 		last_error = "写入存档失败：" + error_string(error)
 108 		return false
 109 	var rename_error: Error = DirAccess.rename_absolute(temporary, path)
 110 	if rename_error != OK:
 111 		last_error = "保存存档失败：" + error_string(rename_error)
 112 		return false
 113 	var readback: Dictionary = read_save(rooms, resources)
 114 	if readback != valid:
 115 		last_error = "存档写入校验失败"
 116 		return false
 117 	return true
 118 
 119 func _reject(message: String) -> Dictionary:
 120 	last_error = message
 121 	return {}
 122 
 123 func uses_browser_storage() -> bool:
 124 	return OS.has_feature("web") or bridge_evaluator.is_valid()
 125 
 126 func _decode(text: String, rooms: RoomCatalog, resources: ResourceCatalog) -> Dictionary:
 127 	var parser := JSON.new()
 128 	if parser.parse(text) != OK:
 129 		return _reject("存档文件已损坏")
 130 	return validate(parser.data, rooms, resources)
 131 
 132 func browser_script(operation: String, encoded: String = "") -> String:
 133 	# JSON.stringify encodes the JSON string again before embedding it in JS source.
 134 	var body: String
 135 	if operation == "read":
 136 		body = "var value = storage.getItem(key); if (value !== null && value.length > 65536) { return JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:'size'}); } return JSON.stringify({ok:true,value:value});"
 137 	elif operation == "write":
 138 		body = "var value = %s; if (value.length > 65536) { return JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:'size'}); } storage.setItem(key, value); var readback = storage.getItem(key); if (readback !== value) { return JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:'readback'}); } return JSON.stringify({ok:true,value:readback});" % JSON.stringify(encoded)
 139 	else:
 140 		return "JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:'operation'})"
 141 	return "(function(){ try { var storage = window.localStorage; var key = %s; %s } catch (error) { return JSON.stringify({ok:false,error:String(error && error.name || 'storage')}); } })()" % [JSON.stringify(BROWSER_KEY), body]
 142 
 143 func _browser_result(script: String) -> Dictionary:
 144 	var raw: Variant = bridge_evaluator.call(script) if bridge_evaluator.is_valid() else JavaScriptBridge.eval(script)
 145 	if not raw is String or raw.to_utf8_buffer().size() > MAX_SAVE_BYTES * 3:
 146 		return _reject("浏览器存储不可用或未确认")
 147 	var parser := JSON.new()
 148 	if parser.parse(raw) != OK or not parser.data is Dictionary or not parser.data.get("ok") is bool:
 149 		return _reject("浏览器存储响应无效")
 150 	var response: Dictionary = parser.data
 151 	if not response.ok:
 152 		return _reject("浏览器无法保存或读取进度（配额、权限或校验失败）")
 153 	if not response.has("value"):
 154 		return _reject("浏览器存储响应缺少数据")
 155 	last_error = ""
 156 	return response
